Automatic link cases require actual callback, exactly one request, exact bot route/body and visible accepted receipt.

Automatic ordered links require two ordered bodies. The two partial failure cases use the original HTTP fixture object, inject HTTP500 only at second bot POST, require rejection with first receipt and exactly two bot requests.
